security_audit.summary: All 370 static alerts are false positives involving documentation links, language examples, credential references, or explicitly scoped production tooling. One separate concern is the instruction to transmit login authorization codes through chat, which unnecessarily exposes sensitive authentication material. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration, destructive behavior, or audit-directed prompt injection in the reviewed material.

remediation.issue: The login fallback asks users to send authorization codes and state through chat.
remediation.suggestion: Use a direct browser callback or secure local input for login completion. Remove the assurance that sharing authorization artifacts through chat is harmless.

content.value_statement: Video production requires coordinating creative direction, generated assets, timing, and delivery. This skill guides Hypit workflows from reference analysis to editable composition and reviewed exports.
actual_capabilities: Analyze supplied reference videos using transcripts, timed frames, and visual grids.
Develop briefs, treatments, scripts, and prompts for image, video, and voice generation.
Author SVML Sources, SVS Recipes, and SVRun files with explicit media reuse.
Compose captions, motion graphics, visual clips, and audio through installed or project-defined components.
Guide Runtime Profile configuration, service selection, credential references, and scoped local tool preparation.
Review productions through Studio playback and snapshots, then guide final rendering and export inspection.
limitations: The skill provides instructions and examples, not the Hypit executable or model credits.
Generation requires compatible providers, supported models, account access, and an approved spending scope.
Local processing can require FFmpeg, a compatible browser, Python tooling, or downloaded model weights.
Successful delivery depends on available services, generated media quality, and inspection of the actual output.

prompt_templates.title: Define a First Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a [duration] video about [topic] for [audience]. Draft a brief and treatment, and identify required tools before installation or spending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first Hypit production.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [reference video] and explain its pacing, captions, and visual structure. Propose an adaptation for [subject] and record the brief and treatment.

prompt_templates.title: Compose a Product Walkthrough
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Hypit walkthrough of [product page] using real captures, [script], and readable captions. Confirm service choices and budget before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Marketer combining interface evidence with directed media.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a Production Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [project] and [Run]. Create a reusable component for [visual behavior], expose useful controls, preserve accepted Outputs, and review the changed interval before export.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user extending an editable production.

output_examples.input: Plan a 30-second explainer from a supplied product reference.
output: Brief: Define the audience, product claim, required evidence, duration, and approved spending scope.
Treatment: Open with the problem, demonstrate the key interaction, and finish with a clear product result.
Production plan: Identify captures, narration, captions, and graphics, then confirm the required service connections.

output_examples.input: Improve captions in an existing production without generating new performance footage.
output: Reuse plan: Select the accepted performance Outputs explicitly in the revised Run.
Composition changes: Adjust caption grouping, placement, and timing at the owning Source or component.
Review notes: Inspect representative frames and watch the affected interval before approving the export.

best_practices: Record the brief, chosen services, and approved spending scope before submitting paid work.
Reuse accepted Outputs explicitly and inspect the remaining planned requests before creating a new Build.
Keep credentials and authorization codes out of chat, and review the actual video with sound before delivery.
anti_patterns: Treating skill installation as proof that model accounts, credits, or local tools are ready.
Repeating Builds without selecting reusable Outputs or checking for an already running attempt.
Presenting an unreviewed preview or authored interface illustration as verified final evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill include the Hypit executable?
faq.answer: No. Install the executable separately, or locate an existing compatible installation before preparing the production.

faq.question: Are generation services or model credits included?
faq.answer: No. Hosted services require their own accounts and billing, and paid work needs an agreed spending scope.

faq.question: Must I use HypiHub?
faq.answer: No. HypiHub is the recommended integrated option, but compatible providers can connect your chosen service or deployment.

faq.question: Can I use existing footage and generated media together?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow combines supplied files, generated assets, and explicitly selected Outputs from earlier Builds.

faq.question: Can I revise captions without regenerating the video performance?
faq.answer: Yes. Select the accepted media Outputs explicitly, revise the composition, and check the planned requests before building again.

faq.question: How should I handle credentials during setup?
faq.answer: Use supported credential stores, secure terminal input, private file import, or direct browser authorization. Keep secret values and authorization codes out of chat.
